note: Wooded campground on Highway K near Jadwin, between the Cedar Grove and Akers Ferry accesses of the Current River (the river is a few miles off; outfitters shuttle from Akers). Camp store with fuel and pizza, horse stalls and riding trails onto the adjoining national forest. One RV or tent per site; a second tent is $15. Sites also rent by the week and month. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the operator's site and Campspot: $35-45 a night priced as a motorhome (under the gate), 50/30A + water at every RV site, dump station, no sewer, open year-round, no minimum stay found, 42 bookable RV sites to 86 ft. A nightly park: all 42 RV sites were open on a November weeknight. Pin is 170 m off in woods: move proposed.
flags: PIN MOVE (~180 m): stored 37.4408,-91.5798 is in woods north of the entrance road. On imagery the RV loops are centred about 37.43915,-91.58035, west of the store (blue roof at 37.43938,-91.57895, which is Campspot's point). Proposed 37.43915,-91.58035.

PRICE GATE: passes. Cheapest motorhome site $35 + 3% park fee = $36.05 before tax and Campspot's fee ($39.05 with it); dearest read $45 + 3%. No per-person or entry fee found (requiresGuest only). Summer 2027 rates could not be read - Campspot returned nothing for 2027-05-22, 2027-06-15 and 2027-06-19 and 'No campsites available' for 2027-04-13, so the booking window does not reach that far yet; the $35-45 is a November 2026 read.

LONG-STAY TESTS: pass. Posts a nightly rate and sells nights through a booking engine; weekly ($230) and monthly ($700, by phone, '30 days or more') rates exist, but on Tuesday 2026-11-17 Campspot showed all 34 back-in and all 8 pull-through sites available, i.e. no site held by a monthly tenant among the 42 it sells. The operator's page counts 36 back-in sites, so at most two are off the engine. Reviews quoted on the operator's page are float-trip and weekend campers.

RATINGS: the operator's site shows a Google widget at 5.0 over 44 reviews (stored evidence had 5.0 over 42 on 2026-10-03); Campspot's own rating 5.0 over 3. Google Maps and RV Life were not re-read directly this pass (stored: RV Life unrated).
PRESENCE: own website with phone (573) 247-7355 (matches stored; Campspot lists the same number), address 12099 State Hwy K, Jadwin, MO 65501, Campspot listing live. New owners per recent reviews.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront, confirmed): wooded ridge-top loops, no water on the property on imagery. The operator's 'river access' wording refers to the Current River accesses a few miles away ('just under three miles from the Current River via horse riding trails' on Campspot) - not a claim about the sites.
HORSES: the campground has stalls and riding trails but is a general campground (RV, tent and group sites, store); not an equestrian-only camp.
